overview: This enum tells the sequencer which set of paired voice lines to use for an entrance scene or a result scene.

None.simple: No paired voice scene type is selected.
None.technical: Declared as uint8 value 0. FGameDataTableRow_UniqueVoicePair::SeuqnecerType and UAbramsSequencerPlayVoiceForUniquePairSection::SequencerType both default to None. A section left at None passes that value to FindUniquePairVoice. Exact row matching finds no candidate because the export has no None rows. GetCommonVoiceIds returns an empty list for this value.

Appearance.simple: Uses the voice lines for a fighter entrance sequence.
Appearance.technical: Declared as uint8 value 1. The sequencer section passes Appearance to FindUniquePairVoice, which keeps only UniqueVoicePair rows whose SeuqnecerType equals Appearance and whose ordered character IDs match the speaking target and teammate. The export has 172 Appearance rows. IsTeamPairGroupAppearance also requires Appearance. The common VoiceGroup fallback uses character_APPEARANCE_01 or character_APPEARANCE_02 based on pair group membership.

Result.simple: Uses the voice lines for the post-match result sequence.
Result.technical: Declared as uint8 value 2. The sequencer section passes Result to FindUniquePairVoice, which keeps only UniqueVoicePair rows whose SeuqnecerType equals Result and whose ordered character IDs match the speaking target and teammate. The export has 172 Result rows. HasVictoryBonusType2 also requires Result. The common VoiceGroup fallback uses character_VICTORY_01 when snapshot bonus type 2 is present. It uses character_VICTORY_02 for all other result snapshots.

Invalid.simple: This reserved marker represents an invalid paired voice scene type.
Invalid.technical: Declared as uint8 value 255. The export has no Invalid rows. No traced consumer compares SequencerType or SeuqnecerType with Invalid. A section holding this value reaches exact row matching with no matching row in the export, so behavior beyond the declaration is unresolved.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_UniqueVoicePair stores the misspelled property SeuqnecerType. The sequencer section stores SequencerType.
FindUniquePairVoice requires an exact match between row type and section type. The reconstructed source has no conversion or wildcard path.
The row constructor and the sequencer section constructor both default the type to None.
The export has 172 Appearance rows and 172 Result rows. It has no None or Invalid rows.
GetCommonVoiceIds builds different VoiceGroup fallback IDs for Appearance and Result. It returns an empty list for other values.
The section copies SequencerType in CopySectionDataFrom and compares it in IsSameSectionData.
No retail Blueprint assets or sequence section assets were inspected, so Blueprint-only behavior is not asserted.
